title: export lab-report --json
description: The config lab's report of one run (report.json of the run folder). verdict is null for a candidate-only run. With --anonymize, production node names are lab-node-NNN, user names <user>, and anonymized is true. Exit 1 (no JSON) when the lab, the run or its report is missing.

scheduler.description: per side: slurmctld scheduler gauges over the side's replay (max, median, samples); real controller microseconds or counts, not time-scaled
